en-US.description:
IFCDC Barbers makes it easy to book professional barbershop appointments. Browse real haircut and style photos, choose your service, pick a barber and time, and pay securely with PayPal.

Features:
• Book appointments with live availability
• View service photos and style gallery before you book
• Secure PayPal checkout and email confirmations
• AURA assistant for quick booking help
• Manage your profile and booking history

Official app for IFCDC Barbers — smart booking powered by real style photos.

review.notes:
APP REVIEW NOTES — Build 63 (Version 1.1.7)

Review Account:
Email: apple.review@ifcdcbarbersapp.com
Password: IFCDC-Review2026!

What's new:
• Multi-tier loyalty rewards from 25 through 200 points
• Rewards are selected and reserved during checkout
• Points are redeemed only after a paid appointment is completed
• Cancelled, failed, refunded, and expired reservations restore points automatically
• Client Rewards includes progress, available/upcoming rewards, redemptions, and history
• Admins can configure tiers and review reports/audit logs

Customer booking flow:
Home → Book → provider → service → date/time → optionally select an available reward → PayPal LIVE checkout.

Rewards:
Profile → Rewards. Five points are awarded per paid, completed appointment. No points are awarded for cancelled, refunded, no-show, failed, or duplicate bookings.

AURA:
AURA is a text assistant for booking information and does not process payments.

Account Deletion:
Profile → Delete Account → Type DELETE → Confirm
